results.note: Metrics for the PRODUCTION model under models/issue_classifier/ (the one app.py / backend/ actually use for inference). See benchmark_baseline below for the separate, provably-unseen-data benchmark artifact's numbers, and semantic_baseline for the Phase 3B embedding-based comparison.
results.test_split_disclaimer: Held out from the same synthetic training dataset. High scores here reflect the dataset's constructed vocabulary separation, not real-world accuracy. See PHASE1_ML_UPGRADE.md and PHASE3A_EVALUATION.md.

multilabel_scaffold.scaffold_notice: This is a demonstration of the multi-label evaluation machinery, not a real multi-label model result. The existing baseline is single-label; predictions here are its top-1 primary_issue output treated as a length-1 set, compared against hand-labelled secondary_issues ground truth. Phase 3B will replace this with genuine multi-label predictions.

benchmark_baseline.note: SEPARATE artifact trained ONLY on data/splits/train.csv (models/benchmark_issue_classifier/) — distinct from the production model evaluated under results.model_role='production' above. See evaluation/benchmark_model.py.

semantic_baseline.note: SEPARATE Phase 3B artifact (models/semantic_issue_classifier/) — pretrained sentence embeddings + Logistic Regression, trained only on data/splits/train.csv. See evaluation/semantic_model.py and evaluation/embeddings.py.

feature_configuration.embedding: spaCy static word vectors, mean-pooled (frozen, not fit on project data)

artifact_size_bytes.note: The classifier is the only artifact this project trained (small — see bytes above). The embedding package is a fixed, off-the-shelf pip dependency, not something fit on project data; its on-disk size is reported separately for an honest total-deployment-cost picture.

reproducibility.validation_usage: model selection only (classifier C), never used to fit the final model
reproducibility.challenge_usage: final diagnostic only, never used for tuning

benchmark.description: TF-IDF (1-2 grams) + Logistic Regression, frozen Phase 3A artifact

semantic.description: en_core_web_md v3.8.0 (frozen pretrained embeddings, mean-pooled) + Logistic Regression

benchmark_vs_semantic_comparison.methodology_note: Both models: same data splits (data/splits/train.csv for fitting, val.csv for model selection only, test.csv for the one-time final benchmark, data/challenge_set.csv as a diagnostic never used for tuning), same classifier family (LogisticRegression, class_weight='balanced'), same random seed. The only real variable is the feature representation. Neither model's metrics were computed differently to favor one over the other.

latency_comparison.note: Semantic latency includes embedding (spaCy vector lookup) + classification; benchmark latency includes TF-IDF transform + classification. Both measured the same way (per-sample loop and batch) on the same test-set texts.

artifact_size_comparison_bytes.note: 'benchmark_total' = TF-IDF vectorizer + classifier (both trained on project data). 'semantic_trained_classifier_only' = just the small classifier head this project trained. 'semantic_plus_embedding_package' additionally counts the ~55MB pretrained spaCy model package as installed — a fixed, shared dependency, not something retrained per-project, but still part of what must be deployed for the semantic model to run at all.
